versos.hebraico: וַֽיְהִי֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה מֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

controles.web: King Solomon was king over all Israel.
controles.kjv: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.
controles.livre: Foi, pois, o rei Salomão rei sobre todo Israel.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֥לֶּה הַשָּׂרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁר־ל֑וֹ עֲזַרְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־צָד֖וֹק הַכֹּהֵֽן׃ס

controles.web: These were the princes whom he had: Azariah the son of Zadok, the priest;
controles.kjv: And these were the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,
controles.livre: E estes foram os príncipes que teve: Azarias filho de Zadoque, sacerdote;

versos.hebraico: אֱלִיחֹ֧רֶף וַאֲחִיָּ֛ה בְּנֵ֥י שִׁישָׁ֖א סֹפְרִ֑ים יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן־אֲחִיל֖וּד הַמַּזְכִּֽיר׃

controles.web: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;
controles.kjv: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.
controles.livre: Eliorefe e Aías, filhos de Sisa, escribas; Josafá filho de Ailude, chanceler;

versos.hebraico: וּבְנָיָ֥הוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָ֖ע עַל־הַצָּבָ֑א וְצָד֥וֹק וְאֶבְיָתָ֖ר כֹּהֲנִֽים׃ס

controles.web: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the army; and Zadok and Abiathar were priests;
controles.kjv: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:
controles.livre: Benaia filho de Joiada era sobre o exército; e Zadoque e Abiatar eram os sacerdotes;

versos.hebraico: וַעֲזַרְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־נָתָ֖ן עַל־הַנִּצָּבִ֑ים וְזָב֧וּד בֶּן־נָתָ֛ן כֹּהֵ֖ן רֵעֶ֥ה הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

controles.web: and Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers; and Zabud the son of Nathan was chief minister, the king’s friend;
controles.kjv: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer, and the king’s friend:
controles.livre: Azarias filho de Natã era sobre os governadores; Zabude filho de Natã era principal oficial, amigo do rei;

versos.hebraico: וַאֲחִישָׁ֖ר עַל־הַבָּ֑יִת וַאֲדֹנִירָ֥ם בֶּן־עַבְדָּ֖א עַל־הַמַּֽס׃ס

controles.web: and Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the men subject to forced labor.
controles.kjv: And Ahishar was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute.
controles.livre: E Aisar era mordomo; e Adonirão filho de Abda era sobre o tributo.

versos.hebraico: וְלִשְׁלֹמֹ֞ה שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֤ר נִצָּבִים֙ עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְכִלְכְּל֥וּ אֶת־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וְאֶת־בֵּית֑וֹ חֹ֧דֶשׁ בַּשָּׁנָ֛ה יִהְיֶ֥ה עַל־אחד לְכַלְכֵּֽל׃ס

controles.web: Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided food for the king and his household: each man had to make provision for a month in the year.
controles.kjv: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.
controles.livre: E tinha Salomão doze governadores sobre todo Israel, os quais mantinham ao rei e à sua casa. Cada um deles estava obrigado a abastecer por um mês no ano.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמוֹתָ֔ם בֶּן־ח֖וּר בְּהַ֥ר אֶפְרָֽיִם׃ס

controles.web: These are their names: Ben Hur, in the hill country of Ephraim;
controles.kjv: And these are their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:
controles.livre: E estes são os nomes deles: Ben-Hur no monte de Efraim;

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־דֶּ֛קֶר בְּמָקַ֥ץ וּבְשַֽׁעַלְבִ֖ים וּבֵ֣ית שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וְאֵיל֖וֹן בֵּ֥ית חָנָֽן׃ס

controles.web: Ben Deker, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Beth Shemesh, and Elon Beth Hanan;
controles.kjv: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Beth–shemesh, and Elon–beth–hanan:
controles.livre: Ben-Dequer, em Macaz, e em Saalbim, e em Bete-Semes, e em Elom-Bete-Hanã;

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־חֶ֖סֶד בָּֽאֲרֻבּ֑וֹת ל֥וֹ שֹׂכֹ֖ה וְכָל־אֶ֥רֶץ חֵֽפֶר׃ס

controles.web: Ben Hesed, in Arubboth (to him belonged Socoh, and all the land of Hepher);
controles.kjv: The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him pertained Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:
controles.livre: Ben-Hesede, em Arubote; este tinha também a Socó e toda a terra de Hefer.

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־אֲבִֽינָדָ֖ב כָּל־נָ֣פַת דֹּ֑אר טָפַת֙ בַּת־שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה הָ֥יְתָה לּ֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃ס

controles.web: Ben Abinadab, in all the height of Dor (he had Taphath the daughter of Solomon as wife);
controles.kjv: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
controles.livre: Ben-Abinadabe, em toda a região de Dor: este tinha por mulher a Tafate filha de Salomão;

versos.hebraico: בַּֽעֲנָא֙ בֶּן־אֲחִיל֔וּד תַּעְנַ֖ךְ וּמְגִדּ֑וֹ וְכָל־בֵּ֣ית שְׁאָ֡ן אֲשֶׁר֩ אֵ֨צֶל צָרְתַ֜נָה מִתַּ֣חַת לְיִזְרְעֶ֗אל מִבֵּ֤ית שְׁאָן֙ עַ֚ד אָבֵ֣ל מְחוֹלָ֔ה עַ֖ד מֵעֵ֥בֶר לְיָקְמֳעָֽם׃ס

controles.web: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth Shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;
controles.kjv: Baana the son of Ahilud; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth–shean, which is by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Beth–shean to Abel–meholah, even unto the place that is beyond Jokneam:
controles.livre: Baana filho de Ailude, em Taanaque e Megido, e em toda Bete-Seã, que é próxima de Zaretã, por abaixo de Jezreel, desde Bete-Seã até Abel-Meolá, e até a outra parte de Jocmeão;

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־גֶּ֖בֶר בְּרָמֹ֣ת גִּלְעָ֑ד ל֡וֹ חַוֺּת֩ יָאִ֨יר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּגִּלְעָ֗ד ל֚וֹ חֶ֤בֶל אַרְגֹּב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּבָּשָׁ֔ן שִׁשִּׁים֙ עָרִ֣ים גְּדֹל֔וֹת חוֹמָ֖ה וּבְרִ֥יחַ נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃ס

controles.web: Ben Geber, in Ramoth Gilead (to him belonged the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; to him belonged the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, sixty great cities with walls and bronze bars);
controles.kjv: The son of Geber, in Ramoth–gilead; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; to him also pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars:
controles.livre: Ben-Geber, em Ramote de Gileade; este tinha também as cidades de Jair filho de Manassés, as quais estavam em Gileade; tinha também a província de Argobe, que era em Basã, sessenta grandes cidades com muro e fechaduras de bronze;

versos.hebraico: אֲחִֽינָדָ֥ב בֶּן־עִדֹּ֖א מַחֲנָֽיְמָה׃

controles.web: Ahinadab the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;
controles.kjv: Ahinadab the son of Iddo had Mahanaim:
controles.livre: Ainadabe filho de Ido, em Maanaim;

versos.hebraico: אֲחִימַ֖עַץ בְּנַפְתָּלִ֑י גַּם־ה֗וּא לָקַ֛ח אֶת־בָּשְׂמַ֥ת בַּת־שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

controles.web: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali (he also took Basemath the daughter of Solomon as wife);
controles.kjv: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
controles.livre: Aimaás em Naftali; este tomou também por mulher a Basemate filha de Salomão.

versos.hebraico: בַּֽעֲנָא֙ בֶּן־חוּשָׁ֔י בְּאָשֵׁ֖ר וּבְעָלֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: Baana the son of Hushai, in Asher and Bealoth;
controles.kjv: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth:
controles.livre: Baaná filho de Husai, em Aser e em Alote;

versos.hebraico: יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן־פָּר֖וּחַ בְּיִשָׂשכָֽר׃ס

controles.web: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar;
controles.kjv: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:
controles.livre: Josafá filho de Parua, em Issacar;

versos.hebraico: שִׁמְעִ֥י בֶן־אֵלָ֖א בְּבִנְיָמִֽן׃ס

controles.web: Shimei the son of Ela, in Benjamin;
controles.kjv: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:
controles.livre: Simei filho de Elá, em Benjamim;

versos.hebraico: גֶּ֥בֶר בֶּן־אֻרִ֖י בְּאֶ֣רֶץ גִּלְעָ֑ד אֶ֜רֶץ סִיח֣וֹן׀ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֗י וְעֹג֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֔ן וּנְצִ֥יב אֶחָ֖ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer who was in the land.
controles.kjv: Geber the son of Uri was in the country of Gilead, in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer which was in the land.
controles.livre: Geber filho de Uri, na terra de Gileade, a terra de Seom rei dos amorreus, e de Ogue rei de Basã; este era o único governador naquela terra.

versos.hebraico: יְהוּדָ֤ה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ רַבִּ֔ים כַּח֥וֹל אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַיָּ֖ם לָרֹ֑ב אֹכְלִ֥ים וְשֹׁתִ֖ים וּשְׂמֵחִֽים׃

controles.web: Judah and Israel were many as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and making merry.
controles.kjv: Judah and Israel were many, as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.
controles.livre: Judá e Israel eram muitos, como a areia que está junto ao mar em multidão, comendo e bebendo e alegrando-se.
